Around [[10,000 BBY]], a brief '''war''' was waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Kumauri Empire]]. The Republic emerged victorious in the conflict.<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
